channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Victor Wembanyama | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Victor Wembanyama from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Glen Big Baby Davis on Victor Wembanyama:

“Right now, I just think he is a young kid, got a big upside. He gives me baby giraffe type of vibes. He is so tall and just awkward moving sometimes because he is 7'4, 7'5.”

Glen Davis on Victor Wembanyama, Oct 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tobias Harris on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Tobias Harris on Wemby

“I've been in this league for 16 years. I've not seen a guy who works as hard as [Wembanyama] works...”

Tobias Harris on Victor Wembanyama, Sep 29, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“My son is a Jalen [Brunson] fan. So he was cheering for them the whole playoffs. I called Rick [Brunson] right before they got to the Finals and told him that they was going to play against Wemby [Victor Wembanyama] now. And if they was going to play against them, that they was going to win.”

Derrick Rose on Victor Wembanyama, Sep 5, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Myles Turner on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Myles Turner:

“The first person that pops in my head is obviously Victor Wembanyama. The reason I say this is not just because of his basketball talent, it's because the way he represents himself, the things he does off the floor, the person that he becomes. As an NBA representative, you have to be a humanitarian. You have to be someone that is highly marketable, someone that is recognizable, but also someone that doesn't have much drama off the floor. Wembanyama has done an amazing job of keeping his family first.”

Myles Turner on Victor Wembanyama, Sep 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Evan Fournier on Victor Wembanyama:

“He's a global megastar, but day-to-day, he's a great guy, focused on others, who really wants to perform. The fact that he's here, I won't lie, has been a motivation for me to keep going. Seeing a kid who wants to achieve things and puts in the work is inspiring... I don't want to come just for the sake of coming.”

Evan Fournier on Victor Wembanyama, Aug 30, 2026. Source: L'Equipe.

item.title: Vincent Collet on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“Victor is going to be the best player in the world. His size and length are amazing, especially because he moves like a guard. He is 7-foot-4, but he moves like a guard. He is very quick and also very smart. That is why, defensively, he is already the best in the world for me,”

Vincent Collet on Victor Wembanyama, Aug 18, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“You know, maybe after this, I'm going to reach out to him. No, I'm not going to call him out. I actually like him. Victor, I heard that you play chess. I think I saw like clips online. Maybe if there's opportunity in the offseason and maybe during the season, if you want, I would like to play against you. And we'll see what happens. I don't know. We'll see what happens.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Victor Wembanyama, Aug 16, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“Maybe not every single season, but your view is, regardless of the market size, if your team is well-managed, if you have a little bit of luck in there, you have a good chance to be in the playoffs and potentially be the champion. And so I think what we’ve seen is societal changes; I think that nobody’s going to say that Victor Wembanyama in San Antonio can’t get global attention because it’s a smaller market.”

Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 24, 2026. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Aday Mara on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Aday Mara on being viewed as a potential Victor Wembanyama stopper:

“Obviously, it's not a bad thing to hear. I think it's going to take time for adjustment, but I'm excited. I'm excited to play against him (and) obviously to play in the NBA. But I feel like I'm going to play against him a lot. If it's not in the NBA, it's going to be on the national team. So I'm excited to get ready to play against him.”

Aday Mara on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Adam Silver on Wemby:

“I’m amazed at Victor. Not just his play on the floor, but he’s such a curious young man. He’s a pleasure to talk to. He’s ever worldly. He’s really dedicated to his craft. He’s got such a bright future ahead of him.”

Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
De’Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama:

“This guy could be he could be an a**hole if he wanted it to be because of the talent that he has at such a young age. And he’s nowhere near that and he’s nowhere near his potential as well. So, I mean, he’s a better person than he is basketball player. And I think that’s saying something because we know we all know how good he is as a basketball player. And he’s just selfless.”

De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Chris Finch:

“I felt that going into Game 6, we tried to make some adjustments that were clearly not right. I kicked myself for doing it, just because I felt we didn't probably need to be as extreme. I flipped the matchups around. We put Rudy Gobert on Castle, and we started with Julius Randle on Victor Wembanyama, trying to mitigate Wembanyama's hot starts. We did a good job, but then Castle got loose on us. It wasn't a scheme that we were overly comfortable with. We've done it from time to time, and it maybe just wouldn't have been the time to do it.”

Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Mitch Johnson on Wemby:

“I'm sure Victor has numerous sources of motivation, and I don't think any of us are surprised or expect anything different than a strong performance,and him being on his front foot in terms of being in attack mode”

Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Spurs coach Mitch Johnson, on his conversations with Victor Wembanyama:

“We definitely had some one-on-one conversations. I don't think he's looking for anything that he’s not throughout the season. I think he’s looking for what my job is, which is to help him, support him, and give him clarity.”

Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Mitchell Robinson, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Robinson:

“Been here for 8 years, now here we are in the Finals. I can truly say I done seen it all.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Mitchell Robinson, Victor Wembanyama, Jun 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“I hesitate to add to pressure on him because, like, look at LeBron. Victor takes care of himself. He can be on the floor for 20 years from now.”

Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 5, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“I think what Victor understands is not to be distracted by all of the fanfare around his career,”

Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 5, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Greg Oden on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Greg Oden on Victor Wembanyama:

“Once he gets Giannis’ weight, it’s over. Everything he’s doing right now, it’s right there. But once he gets that little more muscle, I think it’s f*cking over for the league. For him to shoot like that, as mobile like that, and then for the MF to jump two inches off the ground and damn near at 11 feet, can’t nobody stop that.”

Greg Oden on Victor Wembanyama, Jun 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Chandler Parsons on Chet Holmgren:

“I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama. I really do. I don't think it is like Space Jam, but I don't think he can take two shots in Game 7. You don't play 33 minutes and take two shots. I would rather live and die with going down with Ajay Mitchell out and Jalen Williams out. I would rather have him be 0 for 15 than one for two.”

Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Hart on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Fred Katz:Josh Hart on how he reacts to centers — and, more specifically, Victor Wembanyama — guarding him so they can roam into the lane:

“The only unanimous Defensive Player of the Year is guarding me, so that's a good sign for me, right?... I'm a pretty good player.”

Josh Hart on Victor Wembanyama, May 31, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Miller now hopes that, as part of the NBC revival in his second career as a broadcaster, the players who leave their mark will remember that he was a part of the journey, too.

“I’m honored that — something I’m going to tell my kids — I called Victor Wembanayama’s first playoff game,”

Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle
item.description:
“What’s going to be cool is some of my best moments as a basketball player were on NBC.I hope that five, 10, 15, 20 years from now, when I’m long gone from my broadcasting days, Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, those guys will remember their first game on NBC and hopefully they’ll be like, ‘Oh s—, Reggie Miller was calling our game!’ I hope I have that type of longevity.”

Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“Victor Wembanyama, one of the rare few capable of changing the NBA game, like Stephen Curry, Michael Jordan, or Shaquille O'Neal.”

Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, May 28, 2026. Source: L'Equipe.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on what OKC did to keep San Antonio out of the paint early on in Game 1 and how it can replicate that for a full game tomorrow:

“A combination of things. I agree with that assessment. When you’re looking at a game like that, you’re trying to show what’s sustainable for you and the opponent. Certainly, Wembanyama getting around the basket and being able to dunk the ball or us having to foul out of weakness to prevent a layup isn’t sustainable. The more you give those up, those are very predictably-efficient shots. Clearly, we need to do a better job there. We did a better job early. Credit them. I thought they calibrated to the game well and attacked us well down the stretch. They got to their spots and put us in some tough dilemmas, so they did a nice job.”

Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on what he saw when Chet Holmgren defended Victor Wembanyama during Game 1:

“Everything is on the table. You can’t just throw one pitch throughout the whole series. We have reasons why we approached the game the way we did last night. Some of that was the regular-season matchups. Some of that was the stuff we saw in the first couple of rounds from ourselves and from them. But in these series, one of the things you’ve got to do is you’ve got to figure out what the problems are and you’ve got to put the fires out pretty quickly. That’s our challenge, and we got to work on that with the team today. We’ll continue to work on it tomorrow, and then we’ll throw our best pitch tomorrow night.”

Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama, Chet Holmgren, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“We don’t really give a (bleep), excuse my language. Butat some stage (Wembanyama) should be protected. And if not, he's going to have to protect himself.”

Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama, May 11, 2026. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
He had a different challenge for Wembanyama instead.

“Ask him if he can beat me at chess without the timer bailing him out,”

Rudy Gobert on Victor Wembanyama, May 4, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“It’s (about) how to maximize our spiritual and mental potential, and Victor is a very curious kid.”

Rudy Gobert on Victor Wembanyama, May 4, 2026. Source: New York Times.
